notes.title: Formula Legends: Custom Configuration available
notes.content:
Hello Legends

We've got some great news to share with you: over the next few weeks, Formula Legends will start receiving its first patches, designed to make the game even more fun and engaging.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/e1d82b44ab56c7df9007a3e860134436d7427ad0.png"]The first patch introduces something truly special: Starting today, are available custom configurations on Steam! These will allow you to customize not only your vehicles, but also helmets, driver names, team names, and even team logos.! 
We’ve prepared a step-by-step tutorial  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pHnG0MX-PqmSCdJYd9XscWbxAiqyYMsC/view to help you get started and let your creativity run wild. We can’t wait to see your most imaginative liveries, whether they’re realistic designs or completely out-of-the-box creations. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/26323fab4c142362e7586ac8a3e49cdf35cdb541.png"]

But before we move on, we just want to say a big thank you. Over the past few days, you’ve sent us tons of feedback, suggestions, and ideas, and reading them has been incredibly important for us.

We want to reassure you: we’re listening carefully, and we’re already working on improvements.

That’s why, at the beginning of October, we’ll be releasing a fix patch that focuses on two key areas:

Steering: we’ll introduce an alternative steering option that’s more sensitive and precise, giving players better control and a smoother feel.

Artificial Intelligence: we’ll be tuning AI drivers so they’ll be more careful and avoid bumping into players, drastically reducing those frustrating collisions.

Tracks : We’ve made a series of improvements across multiple areas on all tracks, enhancing both the visual quality and the overall racing experience. Also Tuned more in depth tracks cut area

UI Improvements : Minor fixes on UI.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/b0ec52d79536b991a2f5d5e10bb97e82330a115a.png"]

And this is just the beginning! 

So please keep sending us your thoughts, your ideas, and even your criticisms: they help point us in the right direction. With your support, Formula Legends will only get bigger, better, and more fun.

Thanks again everyone, and… see you on the track, Legends!

notes.title: Release Notes and Known Issues
notes.content:
Dear Legends We’re excited to finally bring Formula Legends to you and this is just the beginning of the journey! This is Our 1.0 Versions of the Game.

Our goal is to support the game long-term, constantly improving it and adding new features to make the experience deeper and more enjoyable.

The team is working tirelessly to deliver the best possible version of the game and is committed to making it even better over time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/677a14b0b40d507fbbb3b38fc1f83de7f0af248b.png"]
Known Issues
Below is a list of currently known issues in the game. We are working on fixes and

improvements, and we’ll keep you updated as soon as patches become available.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Gameplay

● Gap times are displayed incorrectly when the player laps opponents.

● The “Rain ends” message appears when heavy rain stops and light rain begins.

● Occasionally, during the transition from dry to wet track conditions, the car’s speed

   may visibly drop within a few seconds.

● After receiving critical damage penalties, the vehicle’s maximum speed remains

   incorrectly capped at 260 km/h (161 mph), even if repaired during a pit stop.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

AI

● In rare cases on the Belgium track, AI may fail to set valid qualifying lap times and

accumulate excessive race penalties.

● When the player collides from behind with an AI car, the AI tends to brake abruptly

and excessively, making it hard for the player to disengage or steer away.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Leaderboard

● If a player holds an online world-best record and then plays the same track offline,

their personal best is not displayed correctly.

● Occasionally, world record values are set to “99:99.999” when opening photo mode.

● In the first offline Time Attack session (with no previous personal best recorded),

crossing the finish line may display a broken value. The PB updates correctly after

restarting the session.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Graphics

● Random terrain textures on tracks may downgrade to low resolution for a few

seconds.

● Minor and random flickering may occur on off-track surface textures.

● Setting “Effects” to Low causes improper lighting on the track. We recommend

keeping this setting at least on Medium until the issue is fixed.

● On widescreen monitors, camera transitions can appear unsmooth, with unnatural

repositioning.

● Occasional minor and random graphical glitches.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Audio

● Noticeable audio delay on throttle input when using ‘80s vehicles.

Settings

● Difficulty and driving aid settings used in a competition may reset when switching

game modes.

● Driving aids icons do not update if the popup is closed using the Back button in Time

Attack car selection.

● After closing the Race Assists popup with the Back button in Time Attack car

selection, the player cannot change car year or driver.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Various

● Minor text bugs, such as overlapping text or text extending outside boxes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/ca7c14ac4f10d62a65e9823c2bacf5de26202ce7.png"]  
Now
We’ve already implemented some improvements that will be available at launch, and we’ll

keep working with you to grow this project together.

Here’s an overview of what’s coming:

New additions - Improvements already available at launch:

● Cockpit camera

● Lookback camera

● Throttle/Brake indicator

● Improved wet race experience

● Ultrawide screen support

● Constructors’ championship

● Removed driver perks in Time Attack to ensure equal performance for all players
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/6548ac4aaa54403b07f6b5889802c4dc1d442c27.png"]  
Currently in development
● Customizable camera options

● Input deadzones for better Handling Feelings - Steering

● Delta time indicator in Time attack mode

● Additional difficulty levels

● UI improvements

● Improved AI race behavior for collision avoidance (preventing it from crashing into the player)

● Improved AI race behavior for overtaking and defensive strategies

● Improved AI race behavior during pit stops

● Improved collision physics

● Proximity indicators

● PS5 controller support on Steam

● Steering Wheel support + manual shift

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/19ff850feab102f6e24273e71ecc832f3b07a821.png"]  

Thank you for your support: this community is a fundamental part of this project, and we

can’t wait to keep growing together with you.

Engines on, Legends!

notes.title: Warm Up : Formula Legends
notes.content:
Dear Legends,

The countdown is almost over: Formula Legends is about to hit the track!

You’ve already seen glimpses of the speed, the machines, and the action, but what we’ve shown so far is just a warm-up lap. Under the hood, there are still features and surprises waiting to be unleashed, designed to push the limits of racing excitement. 

In this post, we’ll give you a closer look at what’s coming :

Formula Legends ShowRoom
Step inside the garage and admire every legendary vehicles in one place. Explore all the cars up close, compare their details, and discover their unique characteristics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/01460f54701259860724ee73b164432f513491a5.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c878bdcc6976272d8190348b63838499273ae387.jpg"]In this mode, you’ll be able to take stunning photos and explore every fine detail of each car.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/64cf3d3560cab0e39576844ed0cef0e0341107dc.jpg"]
Formula Legends Story mode
Relive the most iconic eras of our meta motorsport from the 1960s to the present day.

Featuring 16 different seasons, each representing a unique racing era with its own cars, technologies, and challenges.
In this mode, you’ll be able to unlock different eras, and as you can see, there will be various ways to unlock certain legends. We’re sure you’ll have a lot of fun figuring out how.

  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/2e26c95263dc34d27df9bbbc43bcf387f76845e8.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/58d44f5f4d2bc6e9535b6a535efe696dea111356.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c70df70c414329892b63430c38f4a32b28de4b81.jpg"]
Formula Legends Custom Championship
Unlike the Story Mode, where rules are pre-set and players can only adjust driving assists and difficulty, the Custom Mode puts you fully in control of the racing experience. 

Here, you’ll have the freedom to fine-tune every aspect of gameplay like disable collisions, ramp up vehicle damage during race contacts, and much more. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/fe432887b23ce7684f07214d5fd180397f8db611.png"] 

This mode also lets you create your very own championship, combining tracks from different eras and customizing weather conditions for each race. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/ea05fd8675615233ad9c4b37cc5a56083a262a7e.png"]

Thank you for your support: the community is a fundamental part of this project, and we can’t wait to keep growing together with you. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/f45f7731fee5c3c176106703dd796c22c8f63497.png"]See you on the grid, Legends !

notes.title: Formula Legends Launches for PC 18th September 2025
notes.content:
Formula Legends  Launches for Steam 18th September 2025 

Following the success of the first public alpha during June’s Steam Next Fest  where over 50,000 players jumped into the action in just one week. We’re proud to officially announce that Formula Legends will launch on September 18.
[previewyoutube="1SgFzRGo8Go;full"][/previewyoutube]

The Milan-based team at 3DClouds has poured their passion, competitive eSports experience, and deep-rooted love for motorsports into Formula Legends  a racing game that’s both accessible and deeply rewarding. Inspired by the cultural significance of motorsport in Italy, the team has crafted a unique arcade racer that celebrates over seven decades of open-wheel racing history.


True-to-Life Racing Features  From tyre wear and fuel consumption, to rubbering-in of racing lines, damage, and dynamic weather conditions — every race is filled with unpredictable, moment-to-moment excitement. Whether you're chasing a podium or mastering your pace lap after lap, Formula Legends offers a thrilling and authentic racing experience.

Download the Free Demo – Available Now Try it for yourself! The free demo is now available on your favorite platform: Steam, PlayStation Network, Xbox Store. Available on Nintendo eShop starting August 14.

Join the Conversation Have feedback or suggestions? Help shape the future of Formula Legends by joining the official 3DClouds Discord  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/16d420bd9fb03720bd5a5bbac0e99d0f894ba185.png"]
Start your engines and we’ll see you on the grid. 🏎️

All ScreenShots are made by https://x.com/TheFourthFocus

What’s In the Demo
Two Game Modes

Custom Race - Choose vehicles, rules, weather, and AI opponents

Time Attack - Pure speed, no distractions. Push your skills to the limit.

Three Iconic Racing Eras

Mid '70s

Early '90s

Mid '20s

Many of the improvements we’re working on are direct responses to the feedback we received during the last demo. We’re listening closely to the community, and every adjustment we make is part of our commitment to delivering the best racing experience possible. Your voice is helping shape this game.

Here’s what’s currently in development:

General polish and performance improvements

Custom Camera system

New UI/HUD elements:

Delta Time

Throttle/Brake indicators

Pit Stop improvements

Wheel Support

More AI improvements

Look Back Camera

Ultrawide screen support 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/06b2aaede2a17015038d293de7096bbd3b6cd6f4.png"]

Stay tuned for more updates and let us know what you think once you try the demo. Your feedback is crucial as we continue to improve the racing experience!

notes.title: Formula Legends Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
“It’s go, Go, GO!” -  Formula Legends Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/ce1ce376ec536ac99063b20c2e6e02426a139cbd.png"]



Brand new gameplay trailer released as part of The Future Games Show Summer Showcase featuring all new cars, tracks, gameplay and more in this historic open-wheeled racer



The launch of the demo was twinned with the premiere of The Future Games Show Summer Showcase which featured a brand new gameplay trailer for Formula Legends that showed off new cars from across the past 70 years of open-wheeled racing and tracks inspired by some of the most beloved venues across the globe.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/fbedd8b06eb5bc252563b464000d6a1613d10d96.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/7292b5c6bfff5c8d5363adb0fece9be1737637e7.png"]

The demo features Belgium’s ‘Ardennes GP’ track with three different configurations (Vintage, Classic, Modern) as well as cars, drivers and teams playfully inspired by mid 70s, early 90s and modern eras. Players can compete in qualifying, races up to 10 laps and Time Trial mode featuring online leaderboard functionality. This small slice of Formula Legends features plenty of details fans of historic motorsport will love and at the same time provides an easy entry point for those who have always wanted to try racing games but have found modern releases too intimidating.

notes.title: Formula Legends coming to Steam
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/c93519c02923fb91277b104ba4428ea62e8e5c88.png

3DClouds unveil an all-new approachable over-the-spoiler arcade racer which is easy to pick up but hard to master and playfully emulates the history of open-wheeled racing


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/13c2195cb079ab69f4e8a642092644c5519c3f2c.png

Formula Legends is an over-the-spoiler racing game that perfectly blends arcade accessibility with the strategic nuance found at the peak of competitive motorsports.Tyre-wear, fuel consumption, rubbering in of racing lines, damage simulation and changeable weather are just some of the elements that make the moment-to-moment gameplay of Formula Legends challenging, unpredictable and most importantly, fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602975/781b63d73738957c8fc5abc7f804e194272db584.png


 Drive Through Time - Slide into the cockpit of legendary cars spanning decades of motorsport history. 16 unique models, each with 7 different liveries recalling the most iconic teams of all time.

 Iconic Circuits, Reimagined - Race across 14 circuits inspired by historic racing locations, each evolving through the years. From sun-soaked yacht docks to sweeping elevations, these tracks blend nostalgia with a fresh twist. 

 Master every element - Rain-soaked asphalt, strategic pit stops, and changing eras demand more than just speed. Fine-tune your racecraft, from battery management to slipstreaming, and chase the perfect lap. 

 Legends Behind the Wheel - Every era has its heroes. The game features over 200 fictional drivers, inspired by real-life icons, each with custom helmets and skill perks: tire whisperers, wet-weather masters, and pit-stop strategists. Their strengths could be the key to victory.

 A Journey Through Racing History - Story Mode invites you to relive the defining moments of Formula racing. Compete in era-based championships, master legendary cars, and carve your name into history. 

 Customize & Compete - Create your own custom races and championships, climb the global leaderboards in Time Attack, and personalize your ride with modding support—from liveries to helmets and trackside sponsors.


Follow Discussion on Discord:
